candidates.change_summary: Replace the low-level call to use call{value:0} to change the call invocation expression (still forwards no ETH, but different syntactic call form) — this is a single-statement edit that can alter behavior in some edge cases involving fallback receive distinctions.
Negate the success check so that the function requires the call to fail instead of succeed, altering state-observable behavior when downstream calls succeed.
Remove the require so the forward proceeds without reverting on a failed external call, changing observable state by allowing execution to continue after failures.
Store the call success into the contract's owner variable when the call succeeds, changing observable state after forward completes.
After the external call, unconditionally set owner to msg.sender, changing the contract's state observable after forward returns.
